items.headline: Blood brothers? Fleck, senior Baranowski share 'great moment'
items.description: After Minnesota's win at Washington, Gophers coach P.J. Fleck grabbed Maverick Baranowski's head with two hands, aggressively wiped the blood from the linebacker's mouth and brushed it on his own left cheek.
